scope: all 6387 retained samples, symmetric current annotation field completion; no new sample matching or model training
frozen_evidence: reuse label_cys_joint uniform fragment/conflict flag unchanged; new UniProt identity/family is sidecar, never relabel
annotation_query: all reviewed UniProt entries length7..50, accession+sequence+protein_name+cc_similarity+organism; same rule before outcome join
identity_join: exact full retained sequence only; multiple matching accessions/families retained, unresolved/conflicting-family states explicit
primary_family: normalized entire author SIMILARITY comment, compatible with previous strict full-family snapshot
secondary_parent_family: first SIMILARITY sentence that states belongs to family or superfamily; explicitly broader hierarchy, exploratory not relaxed strict proof
name_proxy: same old predeclared regex list applied to full symmetric protein-name set; not verified family
comparisons: all original label1 lowCys421 versus highCys1397 and full same-label family background; all lowCys errors/correct plus151/213 pooled and90/110 unflagged pools; retain old/new streams and all label0 background
outcomes_not_selection: include every family and its full denominator regardless correctness, don't choose a family because it supports Cys hypothesis
common_support: report both-Cys membership; >=5 distinct sequence groups per arm gives descriptive support, >=2 such families for class-general hypothesis; counts below retained as small not excluded silently
conditional_analysis: exact-single-family membership only for stratified contrast; multi-family ambiguous cannot be assigned best-fit family; adjustment cannot certify causality or experimental label reliability
controls: reuse original178 independent edges; no new nearest neighbor or pair optimization
prediction_policy: no Test, no new classification threshold/weight, no NN fits, old/new raw errors not matched architecture causal trial
